messages.content: Within a firm consisting of 50 staff members, the management team makes up 20% of the total workforce. From this management team, only 30% are responsible for supervising the whole firm. How many staff members are in charge of supervising the entire firm?

content.text:
# Solving the Management Supervision Problem

## Given Information
- Total staff members: 50
- Management team: 20% of total workforce
- Supervisors (of the entire firm): 30% of the management team

## Step 1: Calculate the Management Team Size
$$\text{Management team} = 20\% \times 50 = \frac{20}{100} \times 50 = 10 \text{ staff members}$$

## Step 2: Calculate the Number of Supervisors
$$\text{Supervisors} = 30\% \times 10 = \frac{30}{100} \times 10 = 3 \text{ staff members}$$

## Answer
**3 staff members** are in charge of supervising the entire firm.
